Sky Sports News understands City are paying a fixed fee of £81.3m plus £4.3m in add-ons. Bouaddi has signed a five-year contract, keeping him at City until the summer of 2031. messages.text: Inside the rebuild of Borussia Dortmund

metadata.summary: There is optimism at Borussia Dortmund again. A new season upon the German giants and the sense of a team not just rebuilding but recapturing something lost. “Overall, we are mixing a good team,” explains head coach Niko Kovac at the club’s training ground.
metadata.content: How Borussia Dortmund are trying to recreate the exciting BVB of the past as they rebuild with youth under Niko Kovac | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Analysis How Borussia Dortmund are trying to recreate the exciting BVB of the past as they rebuild with youth under Niko Kovac Ahead of the return of the Bundesliga, Adam Bate visits Borussia Dortmund to speak to head coach Niko Kovac as well as players and executives to find out how the perennial challengers to Bayern Munich are returning to first principles in an attempt to win again... Adam Bate Football Features Writer @ghostgoal Tuesday 25 August 2026 11:22, UK Image: Head coach Niko Kovac took over at a low ebb but has Borussia Dortmund looking up once more There is optimism at Borussia Dortmund again. A new season upon the German giants and the sense of a team not just rebuilding but recapturing something lost. “Overall, we are mixing a good team,” explains head coach Niko Kovac at the club’s training ground. "Four players left. We bought some new talented players and also one experienced player. So we kept the spine, the experienced players, the goalkeeper, the centre-back, the midfielder. And now we are trying to create the BVB, I would say, from the past." That means the sort of talents who can thrill the fans packed onto that Yellow Wall, those able to play the rock-and-roll football that has defined Dortmund since the days of Jurgen Klopp. More counter-pressing, less control. messages.text: Sterling charged with dangerous driving after crash

metadata.summary: Former England player Raheem Sterling has been charged with dangerous driving and possession of nitrous oxide after a crash involving a Lamborghini on the motorway, police have said.
metadata.content: Raheem Sterling charged with dangerous driving and possession of nitrous oxide after crash | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to content Raheem Sterling charged with dangerous driving and possession of nitrous oxide after crash Raheem Sterling has been charged after being accused of dangerous driving, possession of nitrous oxide for wrongful inhalation and failing to provide a specimen; Sterling is due to appear at Basingstoke Magistrates' Court for a hearing on September 15; the 31-year-old does not have a club Wednesday 26 August 2026 09:13, UK Former England player Raheem Sterling has been charged with dangerous driving and possession of nitrous oxide after a crash involving a Lamborghini on the motorway, police have said. Hampshire and Isle of Wight Constabulary said the charges followed a single-vehicle collision on the M3 southbound, near Minley interchange, on May 28. The 31-year-old is accused of dangerous driving, possession of nitrous oxide for wrongful inhalation and failing to provide a specimen. The force said that no other vehicles were involved in the collision and no injuries were reported. Sterling, from Berkshire, is due to appear at Basingstoke Magistrates' Court for a hearing on September 15. He scored 20 goals in 82 appearances for England, helping Gareth Southgate's side reach the 2018 World Cup semi-finals and the final of Euro 2020.
